name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Between Perch and Mossbank, one goes with Cody and the other with Gus.
If either Willowmere goes with Dale or Pike goes with Wade, then Foxglen goes with Perch.
Either Esther goes with Trout, or Pike goes with Pinehollow — but not both.
Either Willowmere goes with Dale or someone in the Sunfish Family goes with Dale.
Exactly one of Dale, the angler at Foxglen, and the angler at Pinehollow belongs to the Sunfish Family.
Gus belongs to the Sunfish Family if and only if Esther belongs to the North Watershed.
Between Cody and Dale, one goes with Bluegill and the other with Perch.

hints.text: Suppose Dale went with Perch — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Dale goes with Perch.
Perch goes with Dale, so Cody can't go with Perch.
Perch goes with Dale, so Gus can't go with Perch.
…but now the clue “Between Perch and Mossbank, one goes with Cody and the other with Gus” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Dale does not go with Perch.
